description: Find B2B leads by job title, location, and industry using free public search data. No API keys needed.

companyNames.description: Specific companies to target (e.g. 'Google', 'Microsoft'). Leave empty to search all companies.
companyNames.title: Company Names

industries.description: Industries to filter by (e.g. 'SaaS', 'Healthcare', 'Finance'). Appended to search query for filtering.
industries.title: Industries

jobTitles.description: Job titles to search for (e.g. 'Software Engineer', 'CEO', 'Marketing Manager'). Each title generates a separate search query.
jobTitles.title: Job Titles

locations.description: Locations to target (e.g. 'New York', 'California', 'United States'). Leave empty to search globally.
locations.title: Locations

maxLeads.description: Maximum number of leads to return. Higher values require more search queries and take longer.
maxLeads.title: Max Leads

title: Lead Finder Input
